description: Input to the running game. Works headless. A control hidden in a ScrollContainer is scrolled to first. After a lone wheel press, every click lands on the control that took it. Operations: click: press and release a Control named by nodePath or says, or a 3D node where it is drawn; choose (needs nodePath): take an item out of a menu, by its words in text or its place in index; action (needs action): press an action, or hold it; key (needs keycode): press a key, or hold it, not for an open menu; text (needs text): type into the field being edited; mouse_click (needs x, y); mouse_motion (needs x, y); mouse_drag (needs x, y, toX, toY, frames): press at x, y, move a step each frame, release at toX, toY; touch (needs x, y): press a finger at x, y and lift it, or hold it; touch_drag (needs x, y, toX, toY, frames): mouse_drag for one finger; joypad_button (needs button): press a controller button, or hold it; joypad_motion (needs axis, value): move a stick or trigger axis to a value.

action.description: The InputMap action name. A button whose Shortcut holds it is pressed too. ui_cancel does not close an AcceptDialog. For op action.

alt.description: Hold Alt with it. For op key.

axis.description: A name such as left_x or trigger_right, or a JoyAxis number. For op joypad_motion.

button.description: Mouse: left, right, middle, wheel_up, wheel_down or a button number. Default left. Joypad: a name such as a, start, dpad_up or left_shoulder, or a JoyButton number. For ops click, mouse_click, mouse_drag, joypad_button.

ctrl.description: Hold Ctrl with it. For op key.

device.description: Controller, from 0. For ops joypad_button, joypad_motion.

doubleClick.description: Click twice, the second press marked double_click. For ops click, mouse_click.

frames.description: Process frames the stroke takes. A hand takes 20 to 60. For ops mouse_drag, touch_drag.

holdFrames.description: Hold a whole press for this many process frames, then let go. Not with pressed. For ops action, key, mouse_click, joypad_button, joypad_motion, touch.

index.description: click: which equal match, from 0. choose: the item by place. touch: the finger. Default 0. For ops click, choose, touch, touch_drag.

keycode.description: The key name, such as "Space" or "A", or its Godot keycode. For op key.

nodePath.description: click: the Control or 3D node. With says, where to look. choose: the PopupMenu, OptionButton or MenuButton. Pointer ops: the node whose space x and y are in, default the window. Not for ops action, key, text, joypad_button, joypad_motion.

pressed.description: Leave out for a whole press. true holds it down, false lets go of one held. For ops action, key, mouse_click, joypad_button, touch.

projectPath.description: Which game, when several run: its project folder.

relativeX.description: The movement carried. Default the distance from the last injected pointer event. For op mouse_motion.

replace.description: true writes over what the field says, and with text "" empties it. Default false types at the caret. For op text.

says.description: The words on the control to click, matched as runtime_inspect matches says. The best match is pressed, and index picks among equals. For op click.

shift.description: Hold Shift with it. For op key.

text.description: text: what to type. A newline is Enter. choose: the item to take, by what it says as drawn. For ops text, choose.

toX.description: Where the release is, in the space x is in. For ops mouse_drag, touch_drag.

toY.description: As toX. For ops mouse_drag, touch_drag.

value.description: The axis position. Down and right are positive, and a trigger runs 0 to 1. It stays until another motion moves it, or for holdFrames. 0 lets it go back. For op joypad_motion.

via.description: Points the stroke passes through, each [x, y]. Default a straight line. For ops mouse_drag, touch_drag.

x.description: Window pixels, or nodePath's own space when given. click: the point in the control's own space instead of its centre. For ops click, mouse_click, mouse_motion, mouse_drag, touch, touch_drag.

y.description: As x. For ops click, mouse_click, mouse_motion, mouse_drag, touch, touch_drag.

name: runtime_input
title: Send input to the game
